required_work: Give canon-acceptance holds a per-predecessor claim-coverage disposition: hold creation records, per bound predecessor, whether the named successor's claim covers that predecessor's claim, and the ledger supports an owner-ruled per-predecessor release that the drift derivation honors instead of silently re-adding.
objective: Canon-acceptance holds auto-assign one required successor to every bound predecessor with no check that the successor's claim covers each predecessor's claim. boundRecords() unions the canon map, canon_owners citations, and literal-artifact bindings; verifiedByAcceptance() then names every pre-acceptance verified closure a predecessor of one hold with one successor. The result measured on 2026-08-01: osh-0079..osh-0083 name 16 distinct closures under the single successor m5-goalrun-thread-orchestration-seam, while the ADR 0031 per-predecessor test shows only three of them (m3-direct-path-and-exit-proof, m3-goal-kernel-context-and-runtime-truth-spine, m3-work-session-automation-product-journey) have claims that depend on the execution semantics that successor re-proves. The other thirteen are qualified by a successor whose claim does not cover theirs, and the ledger offers no release lane narrower than wholesale withdrawal or full-graph discharge: hold-predecessor-drift re-adds any removed pre-acceptance predecessor by derivation. M0_HOLD_PREDECESSOR_CLAIM_COVERAGE_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if a canon-acceptance hold can qualify a predecessor with no recorded coverage test between the successor's claim and that predecessor's claim, if an owner-ruled per-predecessor release is re-added by the drift derivation, if release requires wholesale hold withdrawal, or if the coverage disposition can change a status, discharge a hold, or weaken the projection of any predecessor the successor genuinely covers.
selected_profile: The open-successor-hold ledger, its seeding/drift derivation in check-open-successor-holds.mjs, and the five sequence-20 holds osh-0079..osh-0083 as the measured case.
current_implementation_evidence: MECHANISM (measured 2026-08-01, tools/check-open-successor-holds.mjs): requiredHolds() derives each canon-acceptance hold's predecessors as boundRecords(subject) — canon-map work_items ∪ records citing the subject in canon_owners ∪ literal-artifact bindings — filtered to closures verified before the acceptance commit (verifiedByAcceptance). One required_successor per hold; no per-predecessor field exists; hold-predecessor-drift re-adds any derived predecessor removed from an open hold; the only narrower states are wholesale requirement_withdrawn_by_owner or successor_admitted on the full graph. PER-PREDECESSOR ADR-0031 TEST (owner ruling 2026-08-01, test: did ADR 0031 change a contract family this record's claim depends on?): KEEP the seam successor — m3-direct-path-and-exit-proof (the direct GoalRun execution path is what ADR 0031 recomposes; runtime_goal_pursuit.rs is the measured zero-reference baseline), m3-goal-kernel-context-and-runtime-truth-spine (goal kernel, runtime truth, harness/context injection are execution semantics), m3-work-session-automation-product-journey (work sessions, harness availability, restart races sit on the managed-session/harness-binding layer ADR 0031 names). RELEASE (claims do not depend on execution semantics) — m4-room-graph-truth-and-product-projection (room admission/graph/projection; m4.md rules the seam outside M4's exit contract; director pre-ruled NO), agentgres-production-readiness-and-branch-effects (substrate head/branch/replay semantics unchanged by ADR 0031), m0-route-final-invoker-pg-census-maintenance (route census; ADR 0031 adds no routes), m1-dual-genesis-and-read-projection and m1-system-genesis-product-journey (genesis identity and journey), m2-agentgres-replay-recovery-and-product-topology (replay/writer-fence/restore), m3-result-lifecycle-negative-retention (result retention and effect fences), m3-pursuit-definition-resolution (RESOLVED RELEASE 2026-08-01, formerly borderline: its claim owns definition immutability, reuse without shared live state, identity preservation across replacement, and definitions-cannot-execute — properties of the PursuitDefinition/component-resolution/Skill/tool-contract families. ADR 0031 recomposed the execution path over five kernel primitives and explicitly left GoalRun placement/identity unchanged; the seam consumes resolved definitions unchanged. Its GoalKernel-grounding aspect feeds definition truth INTO the kernel context; kernel/runtime-truth execution semantics themselves are owned and kept by m3-goal-kernel-context-and-runtime-truth-spine), m9-compute-substrate-canon-successor (hold-mapping meta-record), production-information-flow-and-declassification (labels/egress), production-receipt-checkpoint-and-offline-proof (receipt checkpointing), project-discovery-startup-and-session-chain (RESOLVED RELEASE 2026-08-01, formerly borderline: its claim owns project-discovery/startup predecessor-product-recovery chain integrity — missing predecessor, wrong project/System, orphan resources, fabricated readiness. Its 'session chain' is startup session lineage, not runtime managed-session control; its canon_owners do not include goal-run-execution.md, and ADR 0031's managed-session/harness-binding primitives govern runtime browser/sandbox control and harness-launch admission, not startup chains), scm-publication-effect-and-route-rebuild (publish effect). MECHANICAL BLOCK — CLOSED 2026-08-01: the coverage-disposition lane now exists (holds.mjs predecessor_coverage_dispositions + effectivePredecessors; check-open-successor-holds validations hold-coverage-invalid/-not-a-predecessor/-duplicate/-unexplained; 32 predeclared rejections self-tested including an unjustified removal that drifts even when a release disposition rides along; a valid release un-qualifies exactly its own predecessor). Releases are applied only under the owner ruling, each carrying its test, reasoning, and ruling; predecessor_records stay derived and drift-guarded. This filing changes no status, discharges no hold, and re-stamps nothing.
in_scope: A per-predecessor coverage disposition recorded at hold creation and honored by seeding, drift, projection, and certification consumers.
An owner-ruled release lane narrower than wholesale withdrawal, append-only and content-bound to the ruling that authorized it.
Fail-closed self-tests for every new rejection, per the ledger's existing discipline.
out_of_scope: Discharging or weakening any hold whose successor genuinely covers a predecessor's claim.
Rewriting hold identities, predecessor history, or any review ledger.
The M5 seam and durable-event-subscription successors' own proof obligations.
implementation_actions: Extend the hold shape with a per-predecessor coverage/disposition list validated against the hold's predecessor set.

Apply the recorded 2026-08-01 test table to osh-0079..osh-0083 through the new lane and retain the release evidence.
positive_proof: A hold created over a multi-predecessor acceptance carries a coverage disposition per predecessor; an owner-ruled release survives derivation; every release names its ruling and its reasoning.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject silent under-qualification, a release without a named ruling, a coverage disposition that flips a status or discharges a hold, and a drift pass that re-adds an owner-released predecessor.
compatibility_and_migration: The ledger stays append-only; existing holds gain coverage dispositions without rewriting their identities or transitions.
